enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping through the night with the fan on for white noise
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed with fan running. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Move arm. Turn to back. Breathe deeply. Turn to left side again. Pull blanket over shoulder. Remain still. Breathe regularly.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, switching off the alarm, and reading through written reminders and the day's checklist on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Turn off alarm on phone. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open reminders app. Read written reminders. Open checklist app. Read day's checklist. Put down phone. Sit up on bed. Swing legs over side. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering, brushing teeth, and getting dressed in work uniform
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off tap. Step out of shower. Dry with towel. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Wipe face. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Put on work uniform.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating a flexitarian breakfast of toast and fruit with a cup of tea, and packing a packed lunch
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open fridge. Take out bread. Take out fruit. Take out tea bags. Close fridge. Place bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Fill kettle with water. Place kettle on base. Turn on kettle. Wait for toast. Butter toast. Cut fruit. Pour tea. Sit at table. Eat toast. Eat fruit. Drink tea. Stand up. Open cupboard. Take out lunch box. Open fridge. Take out ingredients. Make sandwich. Place in lunch box. Add fruit. Close lunch box. Place in bag. Close fridge. Turn off kitchen light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting by train and bus from Clayton to the aged-care facility, checking shift notes on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Take out phone. Open shift notes app. Read shift notes. Put away phone. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to train station. Wait for train. Board train. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Take out phone. Check shift notes. Put away phone. Get off train. Walk to aged-care facility.

enriched_activities.activity: Working a day shift as an aged-care support worker, assisting residents with meals, personal care, mobility, and activity programs
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at facility. Clock in. Check roster. Attend handover meeting. Assist resident 1 with breakfast. Feed resident 2. Help resident 3 to bathroom. Assist resident 4 with shower. Help resident 5 get dressed. Transfer resident 6 to wheelchair. Push wheelchair to activity room. Lead group activity. Assist with lunch. Feed resident 7. Help resident 8 with toileting. Assist resident 9 with mobility. Document care notes. Attend afternoon tea. Help resident 10 with dinner. Clock out.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home by bus and train from the aged-care facility to Clayton
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Sit down. Take out phone. Check messages. Put away phone. Get off bus. Walk to train station. Wait for train. Board train. Tap card. Sit down. Look out window. Get off train. Walk home.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking a simple flexitarian dinner using the induction cooker and rice cooker, and washing and chopping vegetables
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open fridge. Take out vegetables. Take out tofu. Close fridge. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add tofu. Stir. Turn off induction cooker. Open rice cooker. Scoop rice into bowl. Place bowl on table. Turn off kitchen light.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner and drinking a cup of tea while listening quietly to the radio
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at table. Pick up fork. Take bite of food. Chew. Swallow. Pick up cup. Sip tea. Put down cup. Pick up fork. Take bite. Chew. Swallow. Turn on radio. Adjust volume. Listen to radio. Pick up cup. Sip tea. Put down cup. Pick up fork. Take bite. Chew. Swallow. Finish meal. Stand up. Clear dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Hand-washing work clothes in the washing machine, hanging them to dry, and tidying the bathroom
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Open washing machine. Place work clothes inside. Add detergent. Close washing machine. Set cycle. Press start. Wait for cycle. Open washing machine. Take out clothes. Hang clothes on drying rack. Wipe bathroom sink. Wipe bathroom mirror. Sweep floor. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Studying Master of Social Work coursework at the desk with the desk lamp on, reading set texts and drafting an assignment on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open computer. Open textbook. Read page 1. Take notes. Read page 2. Take notes. Open assignment document. Type paragraph 1. Type paragraph 2. Type paragraph 3. Read over work. Save document. Close computer. Turn off desk lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Boiling the kettle for herbal tea and preparing tomorrow's lunch and snacks to keep to the weekly budget
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Open cupboard. Take out herbal tea bag. Place in mug. Pour boiling water into mug. Wait for tea. Open fridge. Take out bread. Take out cheese. Make sandwich. Place in lunch box. Take out apple. Place in lunch box. Close lunch box. Place in fridge. Turn off kitchen light. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Texting family in China and replying to housemate messages about plans, then reviewing the weekly cash budget in a notebook
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up phone. Open messaging app. Select family contact. Type message. Send message. Read reply. Type reply. Send reply. Open housemate chat. Read message. Type reply. Send reply. Put down phone. Pick up notebook. Open notebook. Review weekly cash budget. Write notes. Close notebook. Put down notebook.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down with the desk lamp dimmed, reading a book, and looking at the photo of the family dog
enriched_activities.desc: Turn desk lamp to dim. Sit on bed. Pick up book. Open book. Read page 1. Turn page. Read page 2. Turn page. Read page 3. Look at photo of family dog. Put down book. Pick up photo frame. Look at photo. Put down photo frame. Pick up book. Read page 4. Turn page. Read page 5. Close book. Put down book.

enriched_activities.activity: Completing the bedtime routine, setting tomorrow's reminders, turning off the light and fan, and falling asleep
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Walk to bedroom. Change into pajamas. Set alarm on phone for tomorrow. Set reminders on phone. Turn off desk lamp. Turn off fan. Lie on bed. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Fall asleep.
